The '''WD-2550 ''Whydah''-class Yield Conveyer''' was a model of [[freighter]]<ref name="Databank" /> utilized by the [[Trade Federation]] during the [[High Republic Era]].<ref name="Lost / Found" /> One such freighter, the ''[[Fallon]]'', was commanded by [[Captain]] [[Blex]].<ref name="Databank" />
